text:
zoe: short kick: we need an automated Migration Playbook Generator (MPG) that outputs a per-tenant plan (risk score, recommended path, comms copy, credit estimate). aim: reduce CSM burden and speed up ops.
adrien: +1. MPG should ingest simulator report + tenant profile (pin settings, spend, SLA) and emit a single JSON plan + human-readable summary. plan outputs: risk_band, action (auto|cs_assist|block), suggested_dates, credit_offer, rollback_steps.
maria: benchmarks: require p95 latency delta, embed-cosine mean+std, hallucination count on golden set, and token-cost delta. weight quality more heavily. define sample size min=500 requests or last 24h.
noah: runtime: MPG will call /simulate_migration, then call a rule engine. rule engine rules: if risk_score <=0.12 and tenant_spend < 20k -> auto; if risk_score <=0.25 -> cs_assist; else block. make these tunable flags.
olga: infra: add model-catalog metadata fields: migration_policy_default, migration_credit_tier, migration_plan_url. also expose endpoint /tenants/:id/migration_plan. ensure audit log entries for plan generation.
e: notify-bot: patch: branch mpg queued; schema bump tenant_meta.v5 pending.
zoe: comms: plan must include three templated messages (advisory, reminder, final notice) and a single-line exec summary for account owners. include CTA buttons where possible.
adrien: canary strategy in plan: small tenants -> mirrored 2% for 24h; med -> 5% for 72h; large -> replay-only until manual approval. define rollback criteria: quality_drop >2% OR embed_sim_mean <0.88 OR cost_up >25%.
maria: golden prompts owner: maria. also add an automated human-check flag when edge-case prompts fail even if overall score is green.
noah: privacy: scrub inputs (hash + redact PII) before storing; plan must respect tenant opt-out. store only diffs and normalized prompts. TTL 60d.
e: notify-bot: note: add feature flag mpg_enabled.
zoe: billing: credit calc = floor(min(spend*0.05, $1000)) for auto-tier; cs_assist credits by case. record credit_id and ledger tag. legal needs final wording.
adrien: implementers: maria (metrics & rules), noah (simulator infra), olga (catalog schema), zoe (product & comms). milestone: prototype MPG + API in 3 sprints.
zoe: next sync Wed 9am to review first prototype output for two sample tenants. :calendar:
